title: Rusty Lake Mill
text: A mill occasionally appears deep in Reversion Mire. During reversal, its visible Crystal Balls fade and two other positions reveal richer treasures. All four are independent containers: emptying or removing one does not restock it at the next reversal.
The Memory Cube on the bridge also changes between peaceful and corrupted states with the mire. Harvesting it fixes its state; return it to the mire and wait for a reversal to change it again.
